dangerFlagInert:-c.source: ssh (bare invocation, usage banner): -c cipher_spec names a cipher/MAC/kex-algorithm spec, not a config-file effect (tc-6v2dm).

dangerFlagInert:-e.source: ssh (bare invocation, usage banner): -e escape_char sets the escape character, not an exec effect (tc-6v2dm).

dangerFlagInert:-f.source: ssh (bare invocation, usage banner, full): -f backgrounds ssh just before command execution; a boolean toggle, not a force effect (tc-6v2dm).
